items.claim: An exposed RDP service is confirmed by a successful authentication attempt with discovered or sprayed credentials, which yields an interactive desktop session.
items.body:
In practice on HTB this shows up as: ##### Windows Remote Management (**[RDP](https://book.hacktricks.xyz/network-services-pentesting/pentesting-rdp)** TCP 3389 - **[WinRM](https://book.hacktricks.xyz/network-services-pentesting/5985-5986-pentesting-winrm)** TCP 5985, 5986, ¿47001?)
|**Command**|**Description**|
|-|-|
| `nmap -sV -sC 10.129.201.248 -p3389 --script rdp*` | Nmap port scan for RDP |

Write-up provenance: ajcriado/htb-writeups :: Academy/CPTS/Content Summary/04. Footprinting.md (1810 words, classified network).
items.disproof: Refuted when no credential authenticates and Network Level Authentication cannot be bypassed, so no interactive session is obtained.
